scientific_integrity: The PL reduction has a direct graph-cover/Hall proof; the finite checks are corroborative only. The original nonequivariant homotopy theorem is attributed.
scientific_limitations: Odd m and odd L>=3; canonical rotation subgroup only. Ambient small-ladder wedge homotopy uses Agarwal–Basak. No equivariant wedge splitting or reflection classification; possible unindexed equivalent; independent validation absent.
title: Odd cyclic fixed-point reduction for Möbius-ladder perfect-matching complexes
